This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their prominent [[nose]] ridge and brow, as well as slightly elongated cranium.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1}}</ref> a member of this species served as a [[bounty hunter]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild|Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
